_comment: Bounded Promotion Execution Queue — created 2026-05-31. Each item must be run individually via run-promotion-queue.mjs. No broad --apply without explicit --allow-apply and a finite --limit.

queue.description: Regression guard: verify all three MCP sidecars expose HTTP POST /mcp transport. turbovec :8791, engram :8792 (HTTP + stdio), langextract :8793. DOWN is tolerated; TRANSPORT_ERROR fails.
queue.rollback_note: No writes — pure probe. Re-run npm run mcp:opencode-sidecars to restart sidecars if DOWN.
safety_notes: Exit code 1 only if a running sidecar is missing /mcp route (TRANSPORT_ERROR).
DOWN sidecars are tolerated — they need to be started separately.
Do not remove this item from the queue — it is a permanent regression guard.

queue.description: Audit-only: validate knowledge cards in the parent atlas index for required fields, source refs, and integrity. Reports missing/malformed cards. No writes.
safety_notes: Read-only audit. Safe to run at any time.
Review output before running source-ref-candidate-generation.

queue.description: Audit-only: suggest source ref repairs for cards missing source_refs. Outputs NDJSON candidates — does not apply changes.
safety_notes: Run knowledge-card-validation first to establish baseline.
Candidates are suggestions only — apply separately after manual review.

queue.description: Audit-only: verify consolidation claims in parent atlas — checks that merged cards have valid source refs and no duplicate canonical IDs.
safety_notes: Checks for duplicate canonical IDs — safe to run at any time.
If duplicate IDs found, do NOT run apply jobs until resolved.

queue.description: Audit-only: confirm live Postgres schema for task_semantic_packets before persisting alias_id. Reports actual column list, types, and whether alias_id column exists.
queue.rollback_note: No writes. If alias_id column is missing, do NOT run any job that writes alias_id until the column migration is applied.
safety_notes: BLOCKER: alias_id must not be persisted until this check passes with column_exists: true.
If column is missing: run the migration SQL manually, then re-run this preflight.
Do not treat IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md claims as ground truth — query the live schema.

queue.description: Dry-run: verify offline synthesis pipeline on 25 cards without writing to Postgres, Qdrant, or Redis. Confirms LLM reachability and output shape.
queue.rollback_note: No writes in dry-run mode. If LLM is unreachable, check Ollama :11434 and TurboQuant :8090.
safety_notes: Must pass before any bounded-apply synthesis run.
alias-id-schema-preflight must show column_exists: true before switching to --apply.
Default limit 25 — do not increase without reviewing the dry-run output first.

queue.description: Audit-only: compare Qdrant codebase_chunks_768 payload against Postgres parent_atlas_documents. Reports cards in one but not the other, and payload field drift.
safety_notes: DuckDB is validation/mirror only — never authoritative.
CouchDB is disabled — do not attempt CouchDB writes.
Report drift before running any sync jobs.

queue.description: Audit-only: validate the current parent atlas index snapshot for structural integrity, required fields, and internal consistency.
safety_notes: Run before and after any parent atlas apply job.
If validation fails, do not run qdrant-postgres-reconciliation apply lane.
